feature: Library traversal fault isolation and complete-cache preservation
regression_before_fix: Unreadable child directory caused Library::scan and scan_cached to return PermissionDenied, preventing available sibling books from being returned.
assertions: Cached and uncached scans return the readable sibling and a bounded diagnostic
Incomplete traversal preserves previous cache bytes
Permission restoration recovers both books with metadata cache hits
Depth-limited traversal returns accessible new books without replacing the complete cache
A later complete traversal publishes the new metadata cache
commands: nix-shell --run 'cargo fmt --all && cargo test --locked -p femto-reader --test library --test ui -- --nocapture && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features desktop,femto-catalog/tailnet --locked -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --all --check'

firmware_manifest.installation_status: No automatic installer. Verify the actual device partition table and recovery backup before installation.

limitations: No direct injection of directory-iterator or file-type lookup failures
No new full workspace or full reader test suite
No new native simulator or grayscale firmware run
No filesystem snapshot guarantee, physical SD removal, or storage power-loss qualification
